ownerIntent: Preserve the owner's explicit reasoning, instruction-following, routing, execution, and product-logic corrections as durable Mission Control evidence rather than leaving them only in conversation context.
activation: After this standing instruction, when the owner explicitly identifies a concrete logic/reasoning/instruction/routing/execution defect and gives the correction or counterexample, treat that as Mission Control capture intent unless the owner says not to record it.
captureRequirements: Preserve the exact owner correction when it is actually available and safe to publish; otherwise store the smallest bounded summary and label recovery quality.
Record the observed failure separately from the inferred generating mechanism.
Bind each exact source text with a digest when practical.
Deduplicate against existing Mission Control recovery/capture artifacts.
Never publish secrets, private locators, account identifiers, medical/private personal material, or third-party sensitive content merely to preserve an example.
If exact text is sensitive, preserve a sanitized semantic description and state that exact text was intentionally not published.
Do not classify every correction as a SUPERVISION_ESCAPE automatically; capture and adjudication are separate operations.
nonTrigger: Ordinary stylistic preference, casual disagreement, or a substantive domain opinion that does not identify a reasoning/instruction/routing/execution defect is not automatically Mission Control evidence.
